exposure: first trimester serum pregnancy-associated plasma protein A (PAPP-A) MoM values
first trimester serum free beta human chorionic gonadotropin (fbhCG) MoM values
cohort: The study included 88 women with placenta previa who had undergone first trimester aneuploidy screening, 19 of whom were also diagnosed with placenta accreta.
finding: Higher first trimester serum PAPP-A and fbhCG MoM values were found to be associated with placenta accreta in women with placenta previa.
